notes: Hand-written pilot graph for the public SauceDemo demo site. SauceDemo has no requirements document, so requirementRef values use our own numbering. Test users are the public ones listed on the login page.

scenarios.title: Login with a valid username and password
preconditions: User is on the SauceDemo login page

acceptanceCriteria.text: User is redirected to the products page
The products page shows the inventory list

scenarios.title: Login with a valid username and a wrong password
preconditions: User is on the SauceDemo login page
triggers: User enters standard_user and an incorrect password

acceptanceCriteria.text: An error message states that username and password do not match any user
The user stays on the login page

scenarios.title: Login with a locked out user
preconditions: User is on the SauceDemo login page

acceptanceCriteria.text: An error message states that the user has been locked out

scenarios.title: Login with empty username and password
preconditions: User is on the SauceDemo login page

acceptanceCriteria.text: An error message states that the username is required

scenarios.title: Login with a username and an empty password
preconditions: User is on the SauceDemo login page
triggers: User enters standard_user and leaves the password empty

acceptanceCriteria.text: An error message states that the password is required

scenarios.title: Logout using the side menu
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
User is on the products page

acceptanceCriteria.text: User is returned to the login page
Opening the products page URL directly shows an access error instead of the inventory

scenarios.title: Products page lists all products
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
User is on the products page

acceptanceCriteria.text: Six products are listed
Each product shows an image, name, description, price and an Add to cart button

scenarios.title: Sort products by name
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
User is on the products page

acceptanceCriteria.text: Products are ordered alphabetically for A to Z
Products are in reverse alphabetical order for Z to A

scenarios.title: Sort products by price
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
User is on the products page

acceptanceCriteria.text: Products are ordered from the lowest to the highest price
Products are ordered from the highest to the lowest price

scenarios.title: Add a product to the cart
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
User is on the products page
triggers: User clicks Add to cart on a product

acceptanceCriteria.text: The cart badge shows the number of items added
The button on that product changes to Remove

scenarios.title: Remove a product from the cart
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
At least one product is in the cart
triggers: User clicks Remove on a product

acceptanceCriteria.text: The product disappears from the cart list
The cart badge count decreases

scenarios.title: Cart contents stay when navigating between pages
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
At least one product is in the cart
triggers: User opens a product detail page and returns to the products page

acceptanceCriteria.text: The cart badge count is unchanged after navigating

scenarios.title: Checkout requires first name, last name and postal code
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
At least one product is in the cart
triggers: User leaves a required field empty

acceptanceCriteria.text: An error message names the missing first name
An error message names the missing last name
An error message names the missing postal code

scenarios.title: Complete an order end to end
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
At least one product is in the cart
triggers: User enters valid first name, last name and postal code

acceptanceCriteria.text: The order summary lists the selected products with item total, tax and total
A confirmation message thanks the user for the order
The cart is empty after the order is completed
